npc.alexander.stdmod_1: [FR] Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look
npc.alexander.stdmod_2: [FR] I'm selling runes, life rings, wands, rods and crystal balls. I also buy powerful spellbooks. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_1: [FR] Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_2: [FR] Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_3: [FR] Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_4: [FR] Don't head for adventure without a rope and torches! Buy your supplies here!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_5: [FR] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_6: [FR] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_7: [FR] If you need general {equipment}, just ask me for a {trade}. I can also provide you with some general {hints} about the game.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_8: [FR] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_9: [FR] I'm fine. I'm so glad to have you here as my customer.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_10: [FR] I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_11: [FR] My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_12: [FR] It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_13: [FR] If you want to challenge monsters in the {dungeons}, you need some {weapons} and {armor} from the local {merchants}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_14: [FR] If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_15: [FR] Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_16: [FR] The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_17: [FR] Bugs plague this isle, but my wares are bug-free, totally bug-free.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_18: [FR] One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_20: [FR] Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_21: [FR] Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_22: [FR] Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_23: [FR] Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_24: [FR] I you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_25: [FR] Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_26: [FR] Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_27: [FR] Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_28: [FR] A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_29: [FR] The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymour} is the teacher there.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_30: [FR] The monk {Cipfried} takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_31: [FR] As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_32: [FR] If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_33: [FR] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_34: [FR] You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_35: [FR] The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_36: [FR] No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_37: [FR] I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_38: [FR] Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_39: [FR] He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_40: [FR] Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_41: [FR] He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_43: [FR] Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_45: [FR] He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_46: [FR] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_47: [FR] He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_48: [FR] If you are a {premium} adventurer, you should check out {Lee'Delle's} shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_49: [FR] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_50: [FR] She's currently recovering from her travels in the {academy}. It's always nice to chat with her!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_51: [FR] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_52: [FR] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_53: [FR] She sells health {potions} and antidote potions. Also, she buys {blueberries} and {cookies} in case you find any.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_54: [FR] This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_55: [FR] This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with {premium} adventurers though.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_56: [FR] She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_57: [FR] Some call him a hero. He protects the town from {monsters}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_58: [FR] Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_60: [FR] Sorry, I am looking for a SMALL axe.
npc.alia.stdmod_1: [FR] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.alia.stdmod_2: [FR] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.alia.stdmod_4: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.alia.stdmod_7: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.alia.stdmod_9: [FR] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.alia.stdmod_11: [FR] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.alia.stdmod_12: [FR] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.alia.stdmod_13: [FR] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.alia.stdmod_14: [FR] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.alia.stdmod_15: [FR] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.alia.stdmod_16: [FR] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.alia.stdmod_17: [FR] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alia.stdmod_18: [FR] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.alia.stdmod_19: [FR] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.alia.stdmod_20: [FR] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.alia.stdmod_21: [FR] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.alia.stdmod_22: [FR] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alia.stdmod_23: [FR] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.alia.stdmod_24: [FR] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_1: [FR] Outside of our secret {realm} my siblings and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_2: [FR] We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_3: [FR] We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_4: [FR] We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_5: [FR] I can sense a kind of dark energy lately. It is pervading this world, more and more every day. Yet I don't know where it arises from nor what we could do to dispel it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_6: [FR] It is rather subversive, so most creatures won't sense it ... yet. But its corrosive power has already begun to affect my kind and our hidden realm in unpleasant ways.
npc.alternative_rock.stdmod_1: [FR] Passages to Tibia, Folda and Vega.
npc.alternative_rock.stdmod_2: [FR] Find the Golden Anchor and click there, after talk with Navigator.
npc.amanda.stdmod_1: [FR] Well, I would do it myself but I can't leave town for a longer time. Would you be so kind to bring me a vial of holy water from the White Raven Monastery?
npc.amanda.stdmod_2: [FR] I thank you a lot in advance. The power of the holy water from the White Raven Monastery is legendary. For my task it is indispensable. We talk about that when you get back.
npc.amanda.stdmod_3: [FR] It's your decision. I will ask the next believing mind that visits the temple of Banor's blood.
npc.amanda.stdmod_4: [FR] Your mission here on Tibia is to be polite and friendly. The gods will reward you, I promise!
npc.amanda.stdmod_5: [FR] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.amanda.stdmod_6: [FR] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.amanda.stdmod_8: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.amanda.stdmod_10: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.amanda.stdmod_12: [FR] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.amanda.stdmod_14: [FR] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, my child.
npc.amanda.stdmod_15: [FR] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.amanda.stdmod_16: [FR] So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.amanda.stdmod_18: [FR] You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.
npc.amanda.stdmod_19: [FR] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.amanda.stdmod_20: [FR] A blessed stake? That's a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.amanda.stdmod_21: [FR] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.amanda.stdmod_22: [FR] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.anerui.stdmod_1: [FR] I am the mistress of the hunt. At this place you may buy the food our hunts provide.
npc.anerui.stdmod_2: [FR] Hunting is an art, practiced too often by diletantes. Every fool with a bow or a spear considers himself a hunter.
npc.anerui.stdmod_3: [FR] Bow, arrow, and spear are the hunters' best friends. In the northeast of the town one of us may sell such tools.
npc.anerui.stdmod_4: [FR] Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
npc.anerui.stdmod_5: [FR] Nature is not a friend but an unforgiving teacher, and the lessons we have to learn are endless.
npc.anerui.stdmod_6: [FR] Watch the sky, it will tell you.
npc.anerui.stdmod_7: [FR] I guess it's a human god for the human sight of nature. I have not much knowledge of this entity.
npc.anerui.stdmod_8: [FR] If they ever existed they are gone now.
npc.anerui.stdmod_9: [FR] The Kuridai are too agressive not only to people but also to the enviroment. They lack any understanding of the balance that we know as nature.
npc.anerui.stdmod_10: [FR] The balance of nature, of course. It's everywhere, so don't ask but observe and learn.
npc.anerui.stdmod_11: [FR] We try to live in harmony with the forces of nature, may they be living or unliving.
npc.anerui.stdmod_12: [FR] The humans are a loud and ugly race. They lack any grace and are more kin to the orcs then to us.
npc.anerui.stdmod_13: [FR] Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_14: [FR] Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_15: [FR] I despise their presence in our town, but it may be a necessary evil.
npc.anerui.stdmod_16: [FR] That is the race to which I belong.
npc.anerui.stdmod_17: [FR] The magic they wield is all that matters to them.
npc.aneus.stdmod_1: [FR] It was the elite of the whole army. They were called the Red Legion (also known as the bloody legion).
npc.aneus.stdmod_2: [FR] The orcs attacked the workers from time to time and so they disturbed the WORKS on the city.
npc.aneus.stdmod_3: [FR] The soldiers treated the workers like slaves.
npc.aneus.stdmod_4: [FR] The General of the Red Legion became very angry about these attacks and after some months he STROKE back!
npc.archery.stdmod_1: [FR] Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery.stdmod_2: [FR] I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Archery's Hut. I am also {selling} ammunitions.
npc.archery_rook.stdmod_1: [FR] Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery_rook.stdmod_2: [FR] I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Archery's Hut. I am also {selling} ammunitions.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_1: [FR] ...the arithmetical paradox has the same value in a metaphysical way, then...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_2: [FR] Oh my! Alverus!! Did you really...?!?! I have to recalculate it to make sure that I made no mistake.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_4: [FR] ...the minimum square deviation could cause a dislocation, in a matter of fact...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_5: [FR] ...it could be possible to bring the sphere to a destination where...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_6: [FR] Yes, that's it! The elementary particle are corresponding to the... the ... UNBELIEVEABLE!!!
npc.arkulius.stdmod_7: [FR] How dare you asking me this?!? I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the HEADMASTER of this academy!!
npc.arkulius.stdmod_8: [FR] I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the headmaster of this academy.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_9: [FR] I have better things to do than helping you. See that ice statue over there? My dear friend Alverus needs to be revived!
npc.arkulius.stdmod_10: [FR] Time is an illusion and completely irrelevant to me.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_11: [FR] Weapons are for those people who aren't able to use their heads or better what's INSIDE their heads. No offence <coughs>.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_12: [FR] Yeye, I believe you almost feel like home among all those brainless creatures!
npc.a_strange_chalice.stdmod_1: [FR] 'Alice the chalice'... Hmpf, of course I won't TELL you my name, I am UNDERCOVER! Now be quiet or they will hear you.
npc.a_strange_chalice.stdmod_2: [FR] Well, I am drinking most of the time. Er, no I mean - trying to hold my fluids... ah, wait that came out wrong: I am doing research. Let's just keep it at that.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_5: [FR] Manny kinds of. Like {Mesh Kaha Rogh'}, {Za'Kalortith}, {Uth'Byth}, {Uth'Morc}, {Uth'Amon}, {Uth'Maer}, {Uth'Doon}, and {Zatragil}.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_6: [FR] Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_7: [FR] It's high steel called. Only lil' lil' ones know how make.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_8: [FR] It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_9: [FR] Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_10: [FR] Not good to make stuff off. Bad steel it is. But eating magic, so useful is.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_11: [FR] Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_12: [FR] Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Lil' lil ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_13: [FR] Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_14: [FR] Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_15: [FR] One day I'll go and look.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_16: [FR] Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_17: [FR] Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_18: [FR] I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_19: [FR] You shut up. Me not want to hear.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_20: [FR] Do lil' one want to trade a fire sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_21: [FR] Do lil' one want to trade a dragon shield?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_22: [FR] Do lil' one want to trade a sword of valor?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_23: [FR] Do lil' one want to trade a warlord sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_24: [FR] They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_25: [FR] Me not fight them, they not fight me.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_26: [FR] Me wish I could make weapon like it.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_27: [FR] Me people not live here much. Most are far away.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_1: [FR] My name is now known only to the wind and it shall remain like this until I will return to my kin.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_2: [FR] I was a guardian of this glade. I am the last one... everyone had to leave.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_3: [FR] This glade's time is growing short if nothing will be done soon.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_5: [FR] Cruel beings. Large and monstrous, with a single eye, staring at their prey.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_3: [FR] Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_4: [FR] They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_6: [FR] It's a fine library, isn't it?
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_7: [FR] I am 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_9: [FR] Uglyness incarnate. One eye! Imagine that! Horrible!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_10: [FR] These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_12: [FR] I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_13: [FR] Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_14: [FR] Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_15: [FR] Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_16: [FR] The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_18: [FR] Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_19: [FR] Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_20: [FR] You pitiful two-eyed creatures. In our eyes, you look weird. It is pathetic how much you depend on hands and legs. Since we bonelords have more eyes than any creature in the world, it is obvious that you can determine the value of a species by the number of its eyes.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_21: [FR] Our race is very old. Over the time, we have been given many different names by other races. The term bonelord sticks to us for quite a while now. In our language the name of our race is not fix but a complex formula, and as such it always changes for the subjective viewer.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_22: [FR] Our language is beyond comprehension by your lesser beings. It heavily relies on mathemagic. npc.bozo.stdmod_44: [FR] How many eyes does a cyclops have? ... One for each IQ point they have!

npc.bozo.stdmod_50: [FR] Why does the rat have a wooden leg? ... Because it is a former pirate!
npc.bozo.stdmod_51: [FR] Why did the spider cross the road? ... Because it ... oh you already know this one!?

npc.cipfried.stdmod_1: [FR] Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_2: [FR] Come to me if you need healing!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_3: [FR] Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_6: [FR] Me? Oh, I'm just a humble {monk}. Ask me if you need {help} or {healing}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_8: [FR] I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of {Tibia} and to help newcomers in this world.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_9: [FR] You can deposit your money at the bank. That way you won't lose it if you get {killed}. The bank is just under the academy and to the right.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_10: [FR] Your near destiny will be to choose a {vocation} once you are level 8. Whether you will become a {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid} is a big decision!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_11: [FR] That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {monsters}, {quests} and {citizens} around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_12: [FR] How can I help you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_13: [FR] Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {trade} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_14: [FR] I don't have any goods for trade, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can buy or sell.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_15: [FR] A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful not to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_16: [FR] If you face spiders, beware of the {poisonous} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_17: [FR] If you get killed, you will revive in this temple. However, you will lose experience and also equipment, which can be quite painful. Take good care of yourself!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_18: [FR] Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisonous and will make you lose health!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_19: [FR] There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_20: [FR] Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_21: [FR] Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_22: [FR] Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_23: [FR] Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_24: [FR] You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_25: [FR] You can buy equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {gold}. Some {monsters} also carry equipment pieces with them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_26: [FR] Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you know?
npc.cipfried.stdmod_27: [FR] Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_28: [FR] To defend yourself against enemies, you will need a weapon. You can purchase weapons at {Obi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_29: [FR] Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a {monster}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_30: [FR] As a premium adventurer, you are an official tax payer and thus privileged in many ways. For example, you can travel by {ship} and get better deals from {merchants}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_31: [FR] Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat {food} to regain health, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_32: [FR] The academy is just north of here. You can learn helpful things there from {Seymour}, if you wish to!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_33: [FR] Well, King Tibianus of course. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_34: [FR] The {gods} have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The {citizens} will help you if you ask them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_35: [FR] They created {Tibia} and all life on it. Visit our {academy} and learn about them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_36: [FR] Monsters are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously help us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_37: [FR] You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_38: [FR] The sewers are right below this village. North of this temple, you find a sewer grate which leads down, but there are also many small huts in the village which are connected to the sewers.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_39: [FR] I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_40: [FR] To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at {Dixi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_41: [FR] You can earn a fair amount of gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Many {citizens} are buying some of that loot, simply ask around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_42: [FR] Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local {citizens} and ask them for {quests}. You could also help us fight {monsters}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_43: [FR] Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to know where their dens are, best talk to {Dallheim} or {Zerbrus} at the bridges.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_44: [FR] I can see a bright future for you... you will soon embark on a very big adventure and explore the world of {Tibia} - maybe even influence history!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_45: [FR] You are poisoned. I will help you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_47: [FR] You aren't looking really bad, |PLAYERNAME|. I can only help in cases of real emergencies. Raise your health simply by eating {food}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_48: [FR] Obi's {shop} is to the north-east of this humble temple. He sells {weapons}, and his granddaughter {Dixi} sells {armor} and {shields} upstairs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_49: [FR] She recently opened a little bar north of this village.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_50: [FR] That's a sad story. He used to help me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_51: [FR] I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has helped me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_52: [FR] That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son {Tom} completely abandoned her, but I have no idea why.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_53: [FR] In Al Dee's shop you'll find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_54: [FR] Amber is such a lovely girl, and also a very experienced {explorer} and {adventurer}. It's always interesting to chat with her.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_55: [FR] He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_56: [FR] Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin {Billy}. His farm is located left of the temple. You can buy and sell {food} there.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_58: [FR] That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_59: [FR] Hyacinth is a close friend of mine. He left the village many years ago to live in solitude. I think all this bustle here simply was too much for him.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_60: [FR] Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_61: [FR] You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She sells {potions}. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll buy them from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_62: [FR] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_63: [FR] He is the {bank} clerk, making sure your {money} remains safe.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_64: [FR] Seymour is a loyal follower of the {king} and a teacher in the {academy}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_65: [FR] Tom is the main provider for leather armor in this village. You can sell fresh corpses or even minotaur leather to him.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_66: [FR] May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is not passed by dangerous {monsters}!
npc.cornelia.stdmod_2: [FR] I run this armoury. If you want to protect your life, you better buy my wares.
npc.cornell.stdmod_2: [FR] Do you seek a passage to
npc.cornell.stdmod_3: [FR] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.cornell.stdmod_4: [FR] I can travel you to {Grimvale} or {Edron}.
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_1: [FR] I can offer you first & second addons of the following outfit: {Wayfarer}.
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_5: [FR] llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_6: [FR] To achieve the first storage addon you need to give me the Old Cape. Do you have them with you?
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_7: [FR] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_8: [FR] To achieve the second storage addon you need to give me the Sedge Hat. Do you have them with you?
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_9: [FR] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_1: [FR] The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_2: [FR] Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_3: [FR] I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_4: [FR] Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_6: [FR] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_7: [FR] <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_9: [FR] Hmm, |PLAYERNAME|. I really don't know if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_11: [FR] I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_12: [FR] My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_13: [FR] Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_15: [FR] I have to stay here, sorry. But I can heal you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_16: [FR] I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_17: [FR] I'll protect all citizens alike. That is my {job} and duty.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_18: [FR] Did you know that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_19: [FR] There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_20: [FR] Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_21: [FR] You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_22: [FR] Orcs are a constant menace. There are even stronger species of orcs on the main continent.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_23: [FR] Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_24: [FR] They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_25: [FR] The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_26: [FR] A bear can easily kill you if you don't pay attention.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_27: [FR] Wasps are the fastest monsters on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of health, fear for your life!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_28: [FR] Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_29: [FR] Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_31: [FR] All that theory won't help you without some real battle practice.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_32: [FR] A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_33: [FR] I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_34: [FR] The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_35: [FR] There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_37: [FR] The heavenly warrior! Hail to him!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_38: [FR] I'm not interested in such party tricks.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_39: [FR] A nice place for a hero, but nothing for whelps.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_40: [FR] It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_41: [FR] It looks like you have mastered the drill.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_42: [FR] Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_43: [FR] I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are not especially helpful in improving the situation.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_44: [FR] Zerbrus tells me such strange stories about him. Well, he sees him all day from the west bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_45: [FR] He dedicated his life to welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_47: [FR] He has been on this island as long as me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_49: [FR] He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned, just like me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_50: [FR] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_51: [FR] Strange fellow, hides somewhere in the mountains of the isle.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_52: [FR] Her shop is on the {premium} side of town. Best offers around.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_53: [FR] Sometimes I wish I had an easy job like her, selling {potions} all day.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_54: [FR] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_56: [FR] Leave me alone with this wimp.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_57: [FR] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_59: [FR] He's guarding the west bridge. Not that a real threat would lurk on the other side.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_60: [FR] He is a fine cook and farmer. He buys and sells {food}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_61: [FR] You are poisoned. I will help you.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_62: [FR] You are looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_63: [FR] You aren't looking really bad. Eat some food to regain strength.
npc.dane.stdmod_1: [FR] I am the owner of this place of relaxation.
npc.dane.stdmod_5: [FR] I can offer you milk, water, and lemonade.
npc.dane.stdmod_6: [FR] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.dane.stdmod_7: [FR] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.dane.stdmod_8: [FR] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.daniel_steelsoul.stdmod_1: [FR] I am the governor of this isle, Edron, and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_1: [FR] I need the help of some competent {adventurers} to handle a threat to all creation.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_2: [FR] This leaves us with no choice but to take action into our own {hands}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_3: [FR] I guess you know about the {background} and there is no need to tell you that the forces from beyond managed to acquire the parts of the godbreaker in a coup.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_4: [FR] The secret locations of the godbreaker {parts} were revealed and due to trickery, the minions of Variphor aquired all of them.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_5: [FR] Those pieces of knowledge come in several forms and shapes. For most I can give you more or less specific hints where to start your {search}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_6: [FR] You have to {find} the veiled hoard of Zathroth, breach it and destroy the knowledge how to use the godbreaker.
npc.dermot.stdmod_1: [FR] I am the magistrate of this isle.
npc.dermot.stdmod_3: [FR] I am Dermot, the magistrate of this isle.
npc.dermot.stdmod_4: [FR] Time is not important on Fibula.
npc.dermot.stdmod_5: [FR] You are at Fibula. This isle is not very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.
npc.dermot.stdmod_6: [FR] Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
npc.dermot.stdmod_7: [FR] Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
npc.dixi.stdmod_1: [FR] <clears throat> Get your armor and shields heeeeeeere! Upstairs!
npc.dixi.stdmod_2: [FR] Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
npc.dixi.stdmod_3: [FR] Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
npc.dixi.stdmod_4: [FR] Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
npc.dixi.stdmod_5: [FR] Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!
npc.dixi.stdmod_6: [FR] Good day, Ma'am. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.stdmod_7: [FR] Good day, Sir. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.stdmod_11: [FR] <giggles> I love gossiping - err, I mean providing valuable information of course, just tell me a name! <winks>
npc.dixi.stdmod_12: [FR] I'm helping my grandfather {Obi} with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a {trade}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_14: [FR] You can deposit your {money} there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to buy something here.
npc.dixi.stdmod_15: [FR] The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_16: [FR] You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you reach the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_17: [FR] As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, trade with {Lee'Delle} and much more.
npc.dixi.stdmod_18: [FR] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_19: [FR] If you need a torch, go see {Al Dee}'s store.
npc.dixi.stdmod_20: [FR] Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
npc.dixi.stdmod_21: [FR] Are you hungry? Then you should visit {Willie} or {Billy} in the West of town. {Norma} also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick {blueberries} or eat the food some {monsters} carry with them.
npc.dixi.stdmod_22: [FR] {Lily} sells effective health potions and antidote potions against poison.
npc.dixi.stdmod_23: [FR] The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymore} is the teacher there.
npc.dixi.stdmod_24: [FR] King Tibianus is a wise and noble monarch. This island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.dixi.stdmod_25: [FR] Our lovely village will provide shelter for you. Once you are level 8, you can travel to {mainland} and choose a {profession}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_26: [FR] If you want to fight monsters in {dungeons}, you definitely need some good {equipment} such as a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_27: [FR] Just ask me for a {trade} to check out my offers.
npc.dixi.stdmod_28: [FR] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.dixi.stdmod_29: [FR] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_30: [FR] There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Just use them to your liking!
npc.dixi.stdmod_31: [FR] You need to make sure you have some basic {equipment} before you head into dungeons such as the {sewers}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_32: [FR] There is a sewer grate which you can use to enter the sewers just left of this building. Eww, this smell!
npc.dixi.stdmod_34: [FR] How can I help you? I can give you general {hints}, information about {citizens} or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!
npc.dixi.stdmod_35: [FR] I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.dixi.stdmod_36: [FR] You should never embark on an adventure without it. Ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} for it!
npc.dixi.stdmod_37: [FR] Yes, I can sell that to you. Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.dixi.stdmod_38: [FR] Me and my grandfather {Obi} sell {equipment} of all kinds. Just ask him or me for a {trade} if you like to see our offers.
npc.dixi.stdmod_39: [FR] Norma used to sell {equipment}, but she finally earned enough {money} to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!
npc.dixi.stdmod_40: [FR] I never understand what he's talking about.
npc.dixi.stdmod_41: [FR] I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!
npc.dixi.stdmod_42: [FR] Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
npc.dixi.stdmod_43: [FR] In Al Dee's shop you will find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
npc.dixi.stdmod_44: [FR] One day, I want to become a brave adventurer like her and leave this town!
npc.dixi.stdmod_45: [FR] Billy can be kind of scary. He swears a lot and doesn't talk to everybody.
npc.dixi.stdmod_46: [FR] Uncle Willie and {Billy} are farmers, which means they are a good place to sell and buy {food}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_47: [FR] He can heal you if you're injured or poisoned.
npc.dixi.stdmod_48: [FR] Did I hear my name somewhere?
npc.dixi.stdmod_49: [FR] I think he's a bit strange, living alone outside this village. How can he dislike to chat with everybody here?
npc.dixi.stdmod_50: [FR] Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit it!
npc.dixi.stdmod_51: [FR] I always give my cookies and blueberries to Lily. She loves them! Also, she sells {potions}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_52: [FR] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_54: [FR] Seymour is a loyal follower of the {king} and a teacher in the {academy}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_55: [FR] I wish he would talk to his mother {Zirella} again. I feel so sorry for her. Anyway, as Tom is a tanner, you can sell leather and fresh corpses to him.
npc.dixi.stdmod_56: [FR] He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many {monsters} would roam the village of {Rookgaard}!
npc.duria.stdmod_1: [FR] In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_2: [FR] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_3: [FR] I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.edala.stdmod_1: [FR] Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.edala.stdmod_2: [FR] So receive the fire of the suns, pilgrim.
npc.edala.stdmod_3: [FR] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.edala.stdmod_4: [FR] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.edala.stdmod_5: [FR] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_6: [FR] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.edala.stdmod_7: [FR] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_8: [FR] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_9: [FR] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.edala.stdmod_10: [FR] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_11: [FR] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.edala.stdmod_12: [FR] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_13: [FR] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.edala.stdmod_14: [FR] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_15: [FR] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.eddy.stdmod_1: [FR] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eddy.stdmod_2: [FR] I have {beds}, {chairs}, {containers}, {decoration}, {flowers}, {instruments}, {pillows}, {pottery}, {statues}, {tapestries} and {tables}. Which of those would you like to see?
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_1: [FR] Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_2: [FR] A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_3: [FR] A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatnot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_4: [FR] The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_5: [FR] Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_6: [FR] The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could not abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From Venorian beer he will forever refrain.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_7: [FR] During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_8: [FR] A druid from Celesta once talked with a girl, he even bought her a necklace with a huge white pearl. Every time he went home, without money and fame, I guess this girl is cursed, Aruda is the name.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_9: [FR] A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured players from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised gold and many items, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_10: [FR] Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_11: [FR] For a knight from Yanara 10,000 gold were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_12: [FR] A great mage from Celesta went dungeon down deep, he was very brave but his wand was cheap. Among white skeletons one of them was red. Last what he saw were the words: 'You are dead!'
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_13: [FR] A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of Venore, he stole from the dwarven bridge nothing less than an iron ore.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_14: [FR] A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was now his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_15: [FR] A sorcerer from Efidia took his horse and got it saddled, and set out for battle. His horse lost control and threw him into a hole. Now his team lost all hope, because he forgot to bring a rope.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_16: [FR] A knight in Guardia was feeling bored. He wanted to show a dragon lord the taste of his new carlin sword. To its lair then he did go. But before he saw his foe, he met his end by a one hit K.O.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_17: [FR] On Secura a confident knight levelled to main, 840 rats he had slain. 'I am going to kill dragons,' he said while pounding his breastplate. The next thing he saw was: 'You have met a sad fate.'
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_18: [FR] One morning frosty fresh and nice, a knight was fishing on the ice. Catching some pikes for soup, but a dire penguin ate his loot. His angry wife said in the house: Now whole Beneva will laugh at us!
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_19: [FR] A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to no avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_20: [FR] Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed no fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_21: [FR] Our world, our home, our very own plane of existence. We have to protect it, mind you. Underneath all the battles, challenges and monsters there still resides a majestic, yet vulnerable being. A mother to us all.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_22: [FR] A king and a beggar know more than a king alone... ahem, except for King Tibianus. He most certainly would. All hail King Tibianus etc. etc.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_23: [FR] So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A quest to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Yes, we are indeed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_24: [FR] So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A quest to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Yes, we are indeed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_25: [FR] Rather a calling. The weight of words is something not easily lifted by some, yet it can be a mighty weapon to others. ...
npc.edowir.stdmod_1: [FR] I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
npc.edowir.stdmod_2: [FR] I gather wisdom and knowledge. I am also an astrologer.
npc.edvard.stdmod_1: [FR] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edvard.stdmod_2: [FR] Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.
npc.elane.stdmod_1: [FR] We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice trade.
npc.elane.stdmod_2: [FR] I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_3: [FR] I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_4: [FR] Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Besides that we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.
npc.elane.stdmod_5: [FR] Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but no druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.
npc.elane.stdmod_6: [FR] There are many magic spells and runes paladins can use.
npc.elane.stdmod_7: [FR] Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!
npc.elane.stdmod_8: [FR] I am a paladin, not a storyteller.
npc.elane.stdmod_9: [FR] Every paladin profits from his vocation. It has many advantages to be a paladin.
npc.elane.stdmod_10: [FR] We will help you to improve your skills. Besides I offer spells for paladins.
npc.elane.stdmod_11: [FR] Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
npc.elane.stdmod_12: [FR] Some paladins serve in the kings army.
npc.elane.stdmod_14: [FR] How spineless do you have to be to become a jester?
npc.elane.stdmod_16: [FR] He must have been skilled before he became the way he is now. Such a pity.
npc.elane.stdmod_18: [FR] The alcohol he sells shrouds the mind and the eye.
npc.elane.stdmod_19: [FR] One of the most important members of our guild. She makes all the bows and arrows we need.
npc.elane.stdmod_20: [FR] He sells a lot of useful equipment.
npc.elane.stdmod_21: [FR] He and his guildfellows lack the grace of a true warrior.
npc.elane.stdmod_22: [FR] A fine warrior and a skilled general.
npc.elane.stdmod_23: [FR] King Tibianus is a wise ruler.
npc.elane.stdmod_24: [FR] A follower of evil that will get what he deserves one day.
npc.elane.stdmod_25: [FR] Mhm, a little too nice for my taste. Still, it's amazing how she endures all those men stalking her, especially this creepy Oswald.
npc.elane.stdmod_26: [FR] A skilled healer, that's for sure.
npc.elane.stdmod_28: [FR] If there wouldn't be higher powers to protect him...
npc.elane.stdmod_29: [FR] A humble monk and a wise man.
npc.elane.stdmod_30: [FR] Strong man. But a little shy.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_1: [FR] The elves of this city are the casts of the Cenath, the Kuridai, and the Deraisim.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_2: [FR] I am a guardian of this town. I have no time to chat!
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_3: [FR] The Cenath are magic users. Look for them on the upper levels of the town.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_4: [FR] The Deraisim are scouts and hunters. You may find them on the groundlevel of the city.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_6: [FR] If you are looking for that kind of equipment you should ask a Kuridai.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_7: [FR] Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_8: [FR] The city of the humans lies somewhere far to the south beyond the mountains of the dwarfs.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_1: [FR] I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_2: [FR] Well, I sell gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_3: [FR] Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
npc.elvith.stdmod_1: [FR] I sell musical instruments of many kinds.
npc.elvith.stdmod_2: [FR] I sell lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.
npc.elvith.stdmod_3: [FR] Music is an attempt to condensate emotions in harmonies and save them for the times to come.
npc.elvith.stdmod_4: [FR] Time has its own song. Close your eyes and listen to the symphony of the seasons.
npc.elvith.stdmod_5: [FR] Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_6: [FR] Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_7: [FR] We are the most graceful of all races. We feel the music of the universe in our hearts and souls.
npc.elvith.stdmod_8: [FR] They could dig some halls for a big musical event, but they won't listen to me about that matter.
npc.elvith.stdmod_9: [FR] I bet they were great musicians.
npc.elvith.stdmod_10: [FR] That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are not interested in this gods anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_11: [FR] They are too loud and don't even understand the concept of a melody.
npc.elvith.stdmod_12: [FR] The other deraisim are too much concerned with mastering the nature so they don't listen to its music anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_13: [FR] The Cenath think they know the 'art' but the only true art is the music.
npc.elvith.stdmod_14: [FR] I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did not listen to my songs, though.
npc.elvith.stdmod_15: [FR] Sorry, I don't feel like teaching magic today.
npc.elvith.stdmod_16: [FR] For the worst of crimes, criminals are cast into hellgate. It is said no one can return from there. Since it is not actually forbidden to enter hellgate, you might convince Elathriel to grant you entrance.
npc.emma.stdmod_1: [FR] I am privileged to be in service of our beloved queen!
npc.emma.stdmod_2: [FR] We are proud people who fought hard for their freedom and won't allow others to oppress us again.
npc.emma.stdmod_3: [FR] I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
npc.emma.stdmod_4: [FR] I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
npc.emma.stdmod_6: [FR] The Thaians never got over the fact that we gained our independence. They do everything they can to hinder the prospering of our city.
npc.emma.stdmod_7: [FR] Venore is a hellhole of evil. The trade barons' greed lets them plot against all other cities and even against each other.
npc.emma.stdmod_8: [FR] Svargrond is an important project for our city. It's not a colony but many of our people live there alongside those barbarians. If everything works out fine, Carlin and Svargrond will both prosper.
npc.emma.stdmod_9: [FR] Strange people with strange customs live in this city. Luckily, we rarely have to deal with them.
npc.emma.stdmod_10: [FR] Darashia never bothers about the affairs of other cities.
npc.emma.stdmod_11: [FR] It's just another Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant enough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.
npc.emma.stdmod_12: [FR] The dwarfs of Kazordoon usually mind their own business. I wish all other cities would do the same.
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_1: [FR] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_3: [FR] Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_4: [FR] Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_5: [FR] Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_rehal.stdmod_1: [FR] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.emperor_rehal.stdmod_3: [FR] Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.eroth.stdmod_1: [FR] I am the leader of the Cenath caste.
npc.eroth.stdmod_2: [FR] The Kuridai are aggressive and victims of their instincts. Without our help they would surely die in a foolish war.
npc.eroth.stdmod_3: [FR] Gods are for the weak. We will master the world on our own. We need no gods.
npc.eroth.stdmod_4: [FR] They lack the understanding of unity. We are keeping them together and prevent them from being slaughtered one by one.
npc.eroth.stdmod_5: [FR] We are the shepherds of our people. The other castes need our guidance.
npc.eroth.stdmod_6: [FR] Magic comes almost naturally to the Cenath. We keep the secrets of ages.
npc.eroth.stdmod_7: [FR] I can teach the spells 'magic shield', 'destroy field', 'creature illusion', 'chameleon', 'convince creature', and 'summon creature'.
npc.eroth.stdmod_9: [FR] Asha Thrazi. Go, where you have to go.
npc.eruaran.stdmod_1: [FR] What addon you are looking? I need for first addon: {dream warden mask} and for second {dream warden claw}.
npc.eruaran.stdmod_2: [FR] To achieve the first dream addon you need to give me 1 dream warden mask. Do you have them with you?
npc.eruaran.stdmod_3: [FR] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.eruaran.stdmod_4: [FR] To achieve the second dream addon you need to give me 1 dream warden claw. Do you have them with you?
npc.eruaran.stdmod_5: [FR] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.

npc.fenbala.stdmod_2: [FR] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
